aicv-decisions.name: AICV Local Decisions
aicv-decisions.description: Read-only sourced retreat, coworking/day-work, meeting-room, satellite-base and founder-support decisions, plus business-preview discovery. Preserve structured requirements and source dates; explain documented conflicts, unknowns and official action pathways. Catalog identity alone is not researched fit. No live availability, contact, reservation or payment; mock action pilot is separate.

aicv.name: AICV Intelligence Layer
aicv.description: Deterministic retrieval of specific Coachella Valley records — a node, brief, or report by slug, tag, or date range. Use when you know which record you want. For open questions about the region, use aicv-search.

aicv-search.name: AICV Regional Intelligence Search
aicv-search.description: Semantic search across AICV's published Coachella Valley corpus — reports, briefs, and entity profiles. Use when you have a question about the region rather than a specific record to fetch. For a known record, use aicv.
